Derived image items: grid and overlay (clean-room, MIT). Parses item payloads for 'grid' and 'iovl' and composites DynamicImages. Only 8-bit RGB/RGBA/Luma paths are rendered; 16-bit follows the same tiling logic.

Opaque layering in dimg order (top-most last); per-pixel alpha from the layer replaces the canvas pixel (no blending in pure-Nim v1). Canvas fill uses all four fill channels (RGBA, sRGB + linear opacity).
